items.exampleEn: Our school has fairly liberal rules about what students can wear.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校對學生的服裝規定相當寬鬆。

items.exampleEn: Each year, thousands of immigrants come to this country to work or study.
items.exampleZh: 每年都有數千名移民來到這個國家工作或讀書。

items.exampleEn: It is a convention in many countries to shake hands when you meet someone.
items.exampleZh: 在許多國家，和人見面時握手是一種慣例。

items.exampleEn: This phone looks conventional, but it has many new features.
items.exampleZh: 這支手機看起來很普通，但有很多新功能。

items.exampleEn: People often say that music is a universal language.
items.exampleZh: 人們常說音樂是一種共通的語言。

items.exampleEn: Many shops in Taiwan keep a small statue of the god of wealth.
items.exampleZh: 台灣很多商店都擺著一尊小小的財神像。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather became politically active after he retired.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺退休後開始積極參與政治事務。

items.exampleEn: The two tribes used to trade fish for fruit along the river.
items.exampleZh: 那兩個部落以前沿著河用魚交換水果。

items.sentenceEn: Every year, the city hosts a large comic convention downtown.
items.sentenceZh: 這座城市每年都在市中心舉辦大型動漫展。

items.audioEn: My grandparents came to this country as immigrants and opened a small bakery.
items.audioZh: 我的祖父母以移民身分來到這個國家，開了一家小麵包店。
items.questionZh: 說話者的祖父母來到這個國家後做了什麼？
options: Ran their own small bread shop

items.sentenceEn: There is universal agreement that the old bridge needs repairs.
items.sentenceZh: 大家一致同意那座舊橋需要整修。

items.sentenceEn: Fishermen here pray to the god of the sea before a long trip.
items.sentenceZh: 這裡的漁民在長途出海前會向海神祈禱。

items.stemEn: Instead of the ____ white dress, she wore a bright red one at her wedding.
items.stemZh: 她在婚禮上沒有穿傳統的白紗，而是穿了一件鮮紅色的禮服。

items.stemEn: The ____ has lived in the rainforest for thousands of years and speaks its own language.
items.stemZh: 這個部落已經在雨林裡生活了幾千年，說自己的語言。

items.passageEn: When Mei's family moved to Canada, her parents worried about how their children would fit in. As immigrants, they found that many social conventions were different. For example, students called their teachers by their first names, which seemed strange to the family at first. Mei's parents were quite conventional, but they slowly became more liberal and let her join a theater club. Mei learned that kindness is universal, even when customs are not. In history class, she studied the history of the native tribes in the area, and she also read old stories about the gods of the north. Today she works as a translator between two languages and two cultures.
items.passageZh: Mei 一家搬到加拿大時，她的父母擔心孩子們能不能融入。身為移民，他們發現很多社會慣例都不一樣。例如，學生直接叫老師的名字，一開始全家人都覺得很奇怪。Mei 的父母相當傳統，但漸漸變得比較開明，讓她參加了戲劇社。Mei 學到，就算習俗不同，善意卻是到處都通的。在歷史課上，她學到這一帶原住民部落的歷史，也讀了關於北方眾神的古老故事。如今她是一名翻譯，在兩種語言和兩種文化之間工作。

questions.questionZh: 剛到加拿大時，Mei 一家覺得什麼很奇怪？
options: 學生直接叫老師的名字

items.promptZh: 這個話題在政治上很敏感，所以我們的節目不討論。
referenceEn: This topic is politically sensitive, so our show does not discuss it.
Because the topic is politically sensitive, our program avoids it.
rubricZh: politically 修飾形容詞（例如 politically sensitive 等）
「不討論」可寫，例如 does not discuss、avoids、doesn't talk about 等

items.promptZh: 她身為移民，花了三年才習慣這裡的天氣。
referenceEn: As an immigrant, she took three years to get used to the weather here.
She was an immigrant, and it took her three years to get used to the weather here.
rubricZh: immigrant 指移民（例如 as an immigrant 等）
「花了三年才」可寫，例如 took three years to…、it took her three years to… 等
「習慣」可寫，例如 get used to、get accustomed to 等
